(1 comment)

Can you global rename slotId to hostId? A lot of other services use "host" to identify the server rather than "slot". I have a feeling that the term slotId is a very yosemite specific naming of hosts which is not widely used in the industry.

I’ve addressed this and aligned the naming to HostId. I pushed entity-manager [88838] to rename the existing SlotId key to HostId, and I also updated the corresponding consumer patches, including this change and [74073], so they now use HostId consistently as well.

[88838]: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/88838
[74073]: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/74073

I've reverted the naming back to SlotId for now.
If we do need a separate HostId to express the host association independently of the physical slot, I've prepared [88869] for that. Once the direction is confirmed I'll activate [88869] and update this change accordingly.

[88869]: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/88869
